input:
If the Cartesian equation of a line is 6x - 2 = 3y + 1 = 2z - 2, then the vector equation of the line is

Options:
A. r = (1/3 i - 1/3 j + k) + lambda(i + 2j + 3k)
B. r = (i + j + k) + lambda(i + 2j + 3k)
C. r = (-1/3 i + 1/3 j + k) + lambda(i - 2j + 3k)
D. r = (1/3 i - 1/3 j - k) + lambda(i - j + k)

phase_1_understand_the_problem.problem_restatement: Convert symmetric Cartesian relation into point-direction vector form.
phase_1_understand_the_problem.key_observation: Set common parameter and express x,y,z linearly in it.

phase_3_plan_the_approach.strategy: Let each expression equal t, solve x,y,z, and rewrite with convenient parameter lambda.
logical_steps: Step 2: Solve x,y,z in terms of t
Step 3: Rescale parameter to get integer direction ratios

phase_5_verify_answer.answer: A. r = (1/3 i - 1/3 j + k) + lambda(i + 2j + 3k)
